Network Security

Modelagem Adaptativa de Pacotes

A dynamic network management technique that adjusts packet flows based on real-time bandwidth, latency, or application priority, optimizing performance and enforcing policy. See NIST SP 800-115 and IETF RFC 2637.

Definition

A dynamic network management technique that adjusts packet flows based on real-time bandwidth, latency, or application priority, optimizing performance and enforcing policy. See NIST SP 800-115 and IETF RFC 2637.

Operational example

Enable adaptive packet shaping on critical links to prioritize VoIP and video conferencing traffic during peak usage periods.

Localized term

Localized example
